text:
## Escalation Triggers  
### Escalate to Manager If:
- Customer disputes address change
- Multiple address changes in short period
- Address is in high-risk country
- Proof of address cannot be obtained (timeout >30 days)
- AML screening produces match (to Compliance Head)
- Joint account holders dispute change
name: Chunk 46/52

raw_entities.name: Address Change Process
raw_entities.description: An operational workflow governing customer address changes, including verification, dispute handling, and escalation to management when specific risk triggers are identified. The process includes AML screening integration and special handling for joint account holders.
context: Customer disputes address change
Multiple address changes in short period
Address is in high-risk country
Proof of address cannot be obtained (timeout >30 days)

raw_entities.name: Address Dispute Resolution
raw_entities.description: A discrete step triggered when a customer disputes an address change, requiring escalation to management for investigation and resolution.
context: Customer disputes address change

raw_entities.name: Multiple Address Changes Review
raw_entities.description: A verification step that flags and escalates to management when multiple address changes occur within a short timeframe, indicating potential account compromise or fraud.
context: Multiple address changes in short period

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Country Address Check
raw_entities.description: A compliance check that identifies when a customer address is located in a high-risk country and escalates the change to management for approval.
context: Address is in high-risk country

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address Collection
raw_entities.description: A step requiring collection of proof of address documentation from the customer, with a 30-day timeout threshold. Failure to obtain proof within this period triggers escalation to management.
context: Proof of address cannot be obtained (timeout >30 days)

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Execution
raw_entities.description: An automated or manual AML screening step performed on address changes that produces matches against sanctions or PEP lists, requiring immediate escalation to the Compliance Head.
context: AML screening produces match (to Compliance Head)

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Holder Dispute Resolution
raw_entities.description: A step addressing disputes between joint account holders regarding an address change, requiring escalation to management for mediation and resolution.
context: Joint account holders dispute change

raw_entities.name: Branch Manager
raw_entities.description: The manager responsible for reviewing and approving escalated address change cases, including disputes, high-risk addresses, and multiple changes within short periods.
context: Escalate to Manager If:
Customer disputes address change
Multiple address changes in short period

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: The compliance officer responsible for reviewing and approving address changes when AML screening produces a match against sanctions or PEP lists.
context: AML screening produces match (to Compliance Head)

raw_entities.name: Address Change Dispute Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate determining whether a customer's dispute over an address change is valid, with escalation to manager as the path when a dispute is raised.
context: Customer disputes address change

raw_entities.name: Multiple Changes Frequency Check
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that checks whether multiple address changes have occurred within a short period, triggering escalation to manager if the threshold is exceeded.
context: Multiple address changes in short period

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Country Address Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that identifies whether an address is located in a high-risk country, triggering escalation to manager for approval if the condition is met.
context: Address is in high-risk country

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address Timeout Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that checks whether proof of address has been obtained within 30 days, escalating to manager if the timeout is exceeded without documentation.
context: Proof of address cannot be obtained (timeout >30 days)

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Match Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate that determines whether AML screening has produced a match against sanctions or PEP lists, escalating to Compliance Head if a match is identified.
context: AML screening produces match (to Compliance Head)

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Holder Dispute Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision gate determining whether joint account holders are in dispute over an address change, triggering escalation to manager for resolution if a dispute exists.
context: Joint account holders dispute change

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Compliance Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: A mandatory regulatory gate verifying that AML screening has been completed on address changes, with results recorded and escalation triggered if matches are identified.
context: AML screening produces match (to Compliance Head)

raw_entities.name: Proof of Address
raw_entities.description: Documentation required to verify a customer's address change, with a 30-day collection timeout. Failure to obtain proof triggers escalation to management.
context: Proof of address cannot be obtained (timeout >30 days)

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Country Address
raw_entities.description: A customer address located in a high-risk country, requiring management approval and escalation during the address change process.
context: Address is in high-risk country

raw_entities.name: Sanctions and PEP Screening
raw_entities.description: An AML screening process executed on address changes to identify matches against sanctions lists and PEP (Politically Exposed Person) databases, with escalation to Compliance Head if matches are found.
context: AML screening produces match (to Compliance Head)

raw_entities.name: Joint Account Arrangement
raw_entities.description: An account held by multiple customers where disputes over address changes require special handling and escalation to management for resolution between joint holders.
context: Joint account holders dispute change
